_A_AVATAR_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: The AAvatar component shows a person or an organization as a picture, as initials or as an icon. Screen readers read the name and the status.
_A_AVATAR_BASIC_DESCRIPTION_: From name the initials and the color are made. The same name gets always the same color. Without a name an icon is shown.
_A_AVATAR_IMAGE_DESCRIPTION_: src shows an image. If it cannot be loaded, the initials are shown and the event error is emitted.
_A_AVATAR_SHAPE_DESCRIPTION_: shape="square" with rounded corners suits organizations and projects.
_A_AVATAR_COLORS_DESCRIPTION_: By default color="auto" chooses the color by the name. A fixed color is set with color. The text has enough contrast in the light and the dark theme.
_A_AVATAR_STATUS_DESCRIPTION_: status: online, away, busy, offline. The status is part of the accessible name, so it is not shown only by color. statusText replaces its text.
_A_AVATAR_DECORATIVE_DESCRIPTION_: If the name is written next to the avatar, set decorative. The avatar is then hidden from screen readers and the name is not read twice.
_A_AVATAR_CONTENT_DESCRIPTION_: initials replaces the initials, the default slot replaces the whole content. icon sets another icon for an avatar without a name.
_A_AVATAR_GROUP_DESCRIPTION_: AAvatarGroup shows the avatars overlapping. With max the rest is shown as +N. size and shape apply to all avatars of the group.
_A_AVATAR_PROPS_ALT_: Accessible name of the avatar instead of the name.
_A_AVATAR_PROPS_COLOR_: auto (by the name), gray, primary, secondary, tertiary, success, info, warning or danger.
_A_AVATAR_PROPS_DECORATIVE_: Hides the avatar from screen readers, e.g. if the name is written next to it.
_A_AVATAR_PROPS_ICON_: Icon for an avatar without a name and without an image.
_A_AVATAR_PROPS_INITIALS_: Own initials instead of the initials of the name.
_A_AVATAR_PROPS_NAME_: Name of the person or organization: accessible name, initials and color.
_A_AVATAR_PROPS_SIZE_: small, medium, large, xlarge or a number in pixels.
_A_AVATAR_PROPS_STATUS_TEXT_: Own text of the status for screen readers.
_A_AVATAR_GROUP_PROPS_MAX_: Maximum number of shown avatars; the rest is shown as +N.
_A_AVATAR_GROUP_PROPS_SHAPE_: Shape of all avatars of the group.
_A_AVATAR_GROUP_PROPS_SIZE_: Size of all avatars of the group.
_A_AVATAR_EVENTS_ERROR_: The image could not be loaded. Gets { $event, src }.
_A_AVATAR_SLOT_DEFAULT_: Own content instead of the image, the initials or the icon.
